answer: Whom an account talks to and how often forms a stable contact pattern: the same few counterparties, in similar proportions. A session that suddenly interacts with a completely new set of counterparties, in a pattern shared by many accounts, looks like a coordinated farm, not a person. A ocean that appears twice is the tell: the same session cannot live twice. Between a saffron and a knoll lies the whole point: Sybils are cheap to make but expensive to prove.
